document_title: Order of the Commission (final order approving the Stipulation and Settlement Agreement with modifications)
how_obtained: Fetched the PDF over HTTPS with curl (no login, no cookies; the IURC portal serves these documents anonymously). Converted to text with PyMuPDF page.get_text() using default settings, concatenating pages in order with no separator inserted and no other change: line breaks, spacing, hyphenation, running heads, margin line numbers and any OCR errors are left exactly as the extractor produced them.
